Intellectual property issues also generate considerable legal controversy. Questions about copyright ownership, unauthorized distribution, and the boundaries of fair use frequently result in litigation. The digital nature of content distribution has complicated these matters further.

Finally, there are constitutional and free speech controversies. Courts regularly address tensions between freedom of expression protections and obscenity laws, with different legal standards applying across jurisdictions.
